lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-luminance circular pixel clusters arranged in a structured grid pattern across the mid-lateral flank, with regular spacing between local maxima in both horizontal and vertical axes.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Subtle vertical bands of elevated luminance intersect with horizontal rows of spots, forming a matrix of nodes across the visible flank region posterior to the branchial slits.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Multiple parallel longitudinal ridges are visible on the upper third of the flank, characterized by a high-contrast transition from light-reflecting dorsal surfaces to shadowed ventral edges.

other_distinctive_markers: Several small, elongated, dark silhouettes located adjacent to and beneath the trailing edge of the pectoral fin.
